messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Get emergency help or call 911 right away if you take too many tramadol (overdose). When you first start taking tramadol, when your dose is changed, or if you take too much (overdose), serious or life-threatening breathing problems that can lead to death may occur. Ask your healthcare provider about medicines like naloxone or nalmefene that can be used in an emergency to reverse an opioid overdose.
Taking tramadol with other opioid medicines, benzodiazepines, gabapentinoids (gabapentin or pregabalin), alcohol, or other central nervous system depressants (including street drugs) can cause severe drowsiness, decreased awareness, breathing problems, coma, and death.
Do not take tramadol with any other medicine that contains tramadol. Check the label of every pain medicine you take, as some combination products contain tramadol.
Triplet: ["tramadol", "has emergency reversal option", "naloxone"]

The relation 'has emergency reversal option' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug can be reversed in an emergency using the specified medication or agent.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'may require dose adjustment': The subject medication might need a change in dosage under certain conditions or over time.
B. 'not used to treat': The subject drug is inappropriate or contraindicated for the treatment of the condition specified by the object entity.
C. 'similar to': The subject drug is related to or an alternative for the drug specified by the object entity.
D. 'has withdrawal symptom': When the subject drug is stopped abruptly, the patient may experience the symptom specified by the object entity.
E. 'reduces risk of': The subject drug is used to prevent or lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
